# Physics Quantity and final-item delivery

The ten existing Quantity registrations use the frozen `PhysicsMethods.Quantity`
handler contract. Braced arguments create fresh child parsers from the exact
starred, sized, or left/right source expansion; named `order` delivers its FnItem
before reading the argument. Physical `(`, `[`, and `|` openings instead create
an AutoOpen on the caller's stream. Delimiter overrides, child macro budgets,
font scopes, and close-time sized fences retain their source ownership.

AutoClose metadata belongs to the stack item, not its MML node. The final-item
queue preserves that metadata through Not and the middle item of horizontal
Position, drops it when vertical Position creates mpadded, and delivers the
remaining horizontal spacer outside a fence closed by its middle item. Prime,
Dots, Fn, and Nonscript reduce before AutoOpen observes the final node. Observation
precedes the marker's decrement, including for raw bars. A same-owner SetFont
continuation assembles nodes that have already been delivered without observing
them again. Dynamic command priority and genuine child boundaries are unchanged.

Primary sources are MathJax commit
`ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`:
`PhysicsMappings.ts:36–48`, `PhysicsMethods.ts:73–137,928–933`,
`PhysicsItems.AutoOpen`, `BaseItems` pending-item methods, and `Stack.Push`.
The files bind the three original JavaScript asset hashes. No expected SVG is
generated by Go and no SVG assertion normalizes attributes, trees, or geometry.

## Original fixtures

| Fixture | Inputs | Full SVG assertions | Original runtimes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `physics_quantity_mathjax_3_2_2.json.gz` | 2,776 | 2,760 | 16 |
| `physics_final_item_delivery_mathjax_3_2_2.json.gz` | 272 | 270 | 2 |
| `physics_final_item_siblings_mathjax_3_2_2.json.gz` | 312 | 312 | 0 |

There are ten identical input/display pairs shared by the first two fixtures.
The final fixture contains 264 controls outside Quantity and 48 nested-tail
controls, with no overlap with the other inputs. Thus these files preserve
3,350 unique originals: 3,332 SVGs (2,268 valid and 1,064 error SVGs) and 18
runtimes. Tests make 3,342 complete SVG assertions because of the ten overlaps.
All strict originals are well-formed XML. The first-publication overlap count
will be bound separately to the final merged base; these totals do not claim
that every original is newly published.

The 16 NEL observations retain the original null-range exception and assert the
existing bounded U+0085 conversion failure with empty output. The other two
preserve original SpreadLines null-`isInferred` exceptions and require a bounded
failure, not runtime-error parity. The complete original exception strings stay
in the files. The delivery fixture explicitly identifies all ten formerly exact
inputs broken by the initial Quantity preview.

## Current validation boundary

The compiled preview `e97c9b50` is based on Eval `436b429` and predates HLine
integration. Its 270-SVG focused test and existing AutoOpen consumer tests pass;
the full new fixture tests still require the final-base gate run.

Prebuilt comparisons against that same preview baseline find all 3,332 unique
SVGs exact, 1,382 fixes, and no original-runtime acceptance. All 5,621 shared
AutoOpen controls are unchanged. Runtime's 802 controls have 12 exact fixes and
two changed error diagnostics. Published and upstream replays yield 284 and 54
genuine fixes respectively, with no genuine exact regressions. Eight authored
attribute-order controls were checked with 64 complete renders per binary;
their 1,024 raw outputs and complete XML proofs exclude serialization-only
apparent changes from those counts. The inherited unsupported-enclose original
remains raw, not an exact result.

`physics_quantity_residuals.json` separately retains four historical proof
records: two affected Quantity inputs and two existing Eval literal controls.
They are outside the 3,350-input fixture union and outside passing assertions.
The originals require `MissingBeginExtraEnd`; both the new Quantity result and
the unchanged Eval control report `ExtraOrMissingDelims`. Ordinary array body
capture removes the executing EndItem before AutoOpen receives it. Each target's
original equals its literal control's complete original SVG, and the candidate
equals both unchanged control outputs. These are two changed error residuals,
not valid-render changes or exact fixes. Streaming ordinary array closers is a
separate follow-up; no EOF diagnostic substitution is included here.

## Original-only regeneration

Run the pinned Node runtime with `--jitless` and the original asset directory:

```sh
node --jitless testdata/generate_physics_quantity.cjs PINNED_ASSETS
node --jitless testdata/generate_physics_quantity.cjs PINNED_ASSETS physics_final_item_siblings_mathjax_3_2_2.json.gz
node --jitless testdata/generate_physics_quantity.cjs PINNED_ASSETS physics_quantity_residuals.json
node --jitless testdata/generate_physics_final_item_delivery.cjs PINNED_ASSETS
```

The generators validate asset hashes, retain explicit display mode, preserve
literal LS/PS through JSONL framing, and regenerate complete original outputs
only. Raw candidate/baseline qualification fields remain observations; the
generators never read a Go binary or choose references according to Go output.
Final-base composition, published-reference overlap, and the complete frozen
oracle/race/vet/WASM gates remain required before publication.
